headline: Gannon falls at Charleston to close PSAC schedule
dek: Gannon's season ended with a loss at Charleston, closing the conference leader's year at fifteen wins, three draws, and four losses. Even with the final defeat, no other program in the PSAC matched Gannon's win total.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Gannon has scored more than California (Pa.), Shippensburg, and Pitt-Johnstown combined while conceding 27, so its edge is in goals scored rather than defense.

wire.line: Lock Haven, West Chester and Millersville finish level on points behind Gannon at the top.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Shepherd's home match against District of Columbia is the one date on the record that has passed with no result, and it is Shepherd's alone.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Pitt-Johnstown has conceded 48 goals, more than any other program in the conference, and has won one match, drawn two, and lost thirteen.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Lock Haven has drawn nine matches, more than any other program in the conference, against six wins and four losses.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Jaden Howard has kept eight shutouts in goal for West Chester.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Rafael Santos has six goals and eight assists from 56 shots for Seton Hill.

last_match.line: The defeat ended Gannon's November winning streak and closed the PSAC schedule.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
